Message.Name: Index Value Message
Message.Description: Index value messages contain the values associated with a calculated index. They are transmitted when an index is calculated.

Field.Name: NoMDEntries
Field.Description: Number of MDEntries in this message. Will not exceed 255

Field.Name: MDEntries
Field.Description: Market data associated with the index are contained in MDEntries with an MDEntryType indicating the kind of market data.

Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: This message contains only a standard header. The heartbeat will repeat at a regular interval.

Group.Name: MDEntries
Group.Description: The Following Fields Repeat NoMDEntries times

Field.Name: MDEntryType
Field.Description: Entry Type. See table: 10 – MD Entry Type

Value.Name: Index Value
Value.Description: Index Value (Used only in Index Value messages)
